title: Otter.ai alternatives, free and paid
meta_description: Looking for an Otter.ai alternative? We compare Fathom, Fireflies.ai, Granola and tl;dv on free plans, prices and bot-free recording, from official pages.
summary: The best free Otter.ai alternative is Fathom, whose free plan includes unlimited recordings and transcripts. Choose Granola if you never want a bot in your calls, Fireflies.ai if you need more than Otter's six languages, and tl;dv for recordings up to 3 hours on its free plan and EU data hosting.

sections.heading: Why people look for an Otter.ai alternative
body: Otter.ai is easy to start with, but its free plan is tight for real work: each conversation shows only its first 30 minutes of transcript, only your 25 most recent conversations stay visible, and file imports are capped at 3 for the life of the account. It also transcribes just six languages.
If those limits don't bite, Otter.ai is still good value (see the end of this page). If they do, these four are the alternatives worth trying.

facts.text: Otter.ai Basic: 30 minutes per conversation, 25 most recent conversations visible, 3 lifetime imports

sections.heading: Fathom: the best free alternative
body: Fathom's free plan records and transcribes unlimited meetings, which is rare. The catch is the AI: advanced summaries cover only your first 5 calls each month, after which you get a simpler summary template. By default a bot joins Zoom, Meet and Teams; bot-free recording exists but is Mac only and in beta.

facts.text: Unlimited recordings and transcriptions on the free plan
Advanced AI summaries for the first 5 calls a month
Bot-free capture: Mac only; Windows limited alpha for Teams

sections.heading: Granola: the best if you don't want a bot
body: Granola never sends a bot. It listens through your computer's or phone's audio, then turns your own rough notes into full meeting notes. It runs on Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android. The free plan keeps 30 days of meeting history; older notes stay stored but locked until you upgrade.

facts.text: No bot; captures device audio on all plans
Free plan: 30 days of meeting history

sections.heading: Fireflies.ai: the best for languages and team archives
body: Fireflies.ai transcribes 100+ languages (English is primary; most others are labeled beta) and builds a searchable library of every meeting. Its free plan is a trial more than a home: 400 minutes of storage in total. Its paid Pro plan costs slightly more than Otter's.

facts.text: 100+ languages, English primary, others in beta
Free: 400 minutes of storage per team

sections.heading: tl;dv: the best for long recordings and EU hosting
body: tl;dv's free plan keeps unlimited recordings with a 3-hour cap per recording, though AI notes cover only 10 meetings and data is kept for up to 3 months. It can record with or without a bot, and says its data is hosted in the EU. According to tl;dv's website (checked Oct 2026), it never uses meeting recordings to train AI. Paid plans are priced in euros.

facts.text: Free: unlimited recordings, AI notes on 10 meetings, up to 3 months of data, 3-hour recordings
Hosted and stored in the EU
According to tl;dv's website (checked Oct 2026): meeting recordings are never used to train AI

sections.heading: When Otter.ai is still the right choice
body: Stay with Otter.ai if your calls are short and in one of its six languages. Billed yearly, its Pro plan is the cheapest paid plan on this page at $8.33 a month, its desktop app records without a bot, and every plan, including free, gets meeting summaries with action items.

facts.text: Summaries with action items on every plan

verdict.heading: Our verdict
body: Most people leaving Otter.ai's free plan should try Fathom first: unlimited recordings and transcripts cost nothing.

If the bot is the problem, use Granola. If languages are the problem, use Fireflies.ai. And if your calls are short and in English, Otter.ai's paid plan is still the cheapest way to fix its free-plan limits.
